[curious] The biggest games, 2000s to 2011
[thoughtful] Which games earned the most in the United States in the early 2000s, late 2000s, and early 2010s? Here’s one annual sales leader from each period, ranked by tracked full-game dollars.
[excited] Number one, 2002. Grand Theft Auto: Vice City led the annual chart, ahead of Madden NFL 2003. An open-world action game took the top spot.
[impressed] Number two, 2007. Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock ranked first, ahead of Madden NFL 08. Its guitar-controller bundle matters here because a higher-priced bundle can generate more dollars per sale.
[confident] Number three, 2011. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 finished first. The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim was second. Across these three years, three different genres led the same US sales chart.
